answer.summary: Docker build fails at the front-end build step (yarn build) because Graph.tsx has a JSX syntax error: an unclosed <Box> tag near line 290 and an unexpected token at line 292. The change touches Graph.tsx, and a syntax error will repeat on every run, so re-running will not help. Fix the JSX in openaev-front/src/admin/components/graph/Graph.tsx.

evidence.quote: #35 2.354 [builtin:vite-transform] Expected corresponding JSX closing tag for 'Box'.
#35 2.354 [builtin:vite-transform] Unexpected token. Did you mean `{'}'}` or `}`?
